sentences.text: Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 28131 of 2025

Applicant :- Santosh Kumar
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Laxmi Narayan Rathour
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
1.

Sri Laxmi Narayan Rathour, learned counsel for the applicant seeks to withdraw the present application, in which challenge has been raised for quashing the summoning order dated 17.04.2025 in arising out of Complaint Case No. 110 of 2024, (Ekta Bhaskar vs. Santosh Kumar and others)
under sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kuthaund and District Jalaun,
pending in the court of Additional Civil Judge (J.D.)/Judicial Magistrate, Jalaun, on account of technical inherent defect, with liberty to file afresh.
2. Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the same.
3.

entities.text: Ekta Bhaskar vs. Santosh Kumar and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the application is dismissed as withdrawn, with the aforesaid liberty.
4. Office to return the certified copy to learned counsel for the applicants subject to furnishing a photocopy of the same.
